name: Fields
summary:
Fields is not an album you listen to. It is a place you enter.

An immersive VR experience built around the music of electronic producer Die Stadt, Fields dissolves the boundary between sound and space. Each track becomes an environment: shifting fields of light, generative textures, and slow chromatic movements that respond to the music in real time.

Fields is designed for deep listening — a rare kind of attention that VR makes possible. No narrative, no objectives. Only presence.
